newsitem.title: USA: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.
newsitem.headline: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.

text.p: USDA said the 20.419 million bushels wheat, 26.841 million bushels of corn and 394,000 bushels of barley inspected in the week to Oct 17 included the following destinations (1,000 bu):
St. Lawrence Seaway to Egypt 2,122; Spain 1,191.

Gulf to Barbados 50; Bosnia-Herzegovina 919; Colombia 176; Ecuador 643; Egypt 3,858; Honduras 354; Jamaica 294; Kyrgyzstan 257; Mexico 243; Nigeria 309; Peru 482; St Vincent 231; Surinam 108; Zaire 308.

Gulf to Algeria 649; Barbados 149; Cape Verde 283; Taiwan 4,133; Colombia 2,321; Dominican Republic 613; Egypt 4,373; Israel 1,279; Jamaica 400; Japan 6,201; Jordan 1,968; South Korea 2,149; Mexico 1,494; Peru 200; Trinidad 162.
